$schema: clone-website extraction artifact — consumed by scripts/emit-design-system.ts
name: $0 MRR Club

extraction.method: First-party inline stylesheets read in full (home: two <style> blocks, 20.8 KB after stripping base64 webp; playbook: one 12 KB <style>), first-party behaviour scripts read (home main script v3.45, i18n.js, tees.js; playbook inline scripts), Playwright Chromium captures of the boot, menu, tee-select and size-guide states at 1440px plus playbook full-page at 1440px and 390px
extraction.evidence: Original references are retained in docs/design-references/zeromrr-club and the section specifications in docs/research/zeromrr-club.
extraction.note: A 2003 PS2-era console shell for a streetwear drop: night-blue ground, sodium-orange accent, HUD green, cream print ink, Anton display with a hard 2–4px black drop shadow, Press Start 2P for every UI label, chamfered panels and scanlines. The playbook page reuses the same voice on a flatter editorial ground.

--bg.reason: The page ground and three.js clear colour is 'night'. The site has one committed dark look; there is no light theme.

--surface.reason: Raised cards on the playbook (stats, problem cards, steps, tiers) use --panel #13151c; the game's tee panel is the translucent rgba(7,11,24,.8).

--surface-warm.reason: The featured pricing tier and the anchor callout sit on a warm brown-black.

--fg.reason: Primary text is the cream 'print ink' colour of the tees.
--fg.source: home :root --ink:#ece4d0 /* cream print ink = primary text */

--fg-2.reason: Secondary text (subtitles, labels, HUD rows, footnotes) is 'fog' blue.

--border.reason: Strong edges (memory card frame, email inputs, modal buttons, playbook ghost button) are the memory-card blue.

--border-soft.reason: Hairlines on every HUD control, panel, meter and size button are fog at 30%.

--accent.reason: Sodium street-light orange is the single accent: the $0 in the wordmark, the selected menu item, the CTA, links.

--accent-on.reason: Text on the sodium CTA is near-black brown.

--success.reason: HUD green marks success, the Aura meter and the playbook checklists and guarantee.

--warn.reason: Required-field nudges (size buttons flash) use the sodium accent; there is no separate warning hue.

--danger.reason: Form errors and invalid inputs are a pale salmon.

--font-display.reason: Every headline, the wordmark and the menu items are Anton 400, uppercase.

--font-body.reason: Body and UI text on the game is Chakra Petch 500 at 15px; the playbook swaps in Inter (recorded in DESIGN.md).

--font-mono.reason: The .px pixel face carries every HUD label, button label, hint and tag.

--text-xs.reason: The pixel label size after the 2026-11-07 UI fix.

--text-sm.reason: Status lines, form errors and the tee-panel extra copy.

--text-xl.reason: The tee name heading in the select panel.

--text-2xl.reason: Main-menu items, the most repeated display size.

--text-4xl.reason: The title card that blooms in after Press start.

--leading-tight.reason: Display lines are set solid or tighter (.9–1).

--tracking-display.reason: Anton is opened slightly, never tightened.

--space-4.reason: Tee panel row gap and the playbook grid gap.

--space-5.reason: Shell top padding, panel padding, playbook gutter.

--space-6.reason: Boot stack gap, memory card padding, card padding.

--space-8.reason: Playbook hero column gap and stats top margin.

--space-12.reason: Playbook section rhythm (h2 top margin, final CTA).

--section-y-desktop.reason: Each playbook section opens with a 72px-top h2.

--section-y-tablet.reason: The playbook does not change section rhythm at its 860px breakpoint.

--section-y-phone.reason: Unchanged on phones; the game page has no sections (one fixed screen).

--radius-sm.reason: Every game control is square: buttons, inputs, size chips, meters. Corners are cut by clip-path instead.

--radius-md.reason: Playbook media frames and the view-count pill.

--radius-pill.reason: The controller button glyphs (○ ✕) are the only round elements.

--elev-flat.reason: Panels are flat translucent fields with a hairline.

--elev-ring.reason: The memory-card modal: a black keyline then a blue bloom.

--elev-raised.reason: The hard offset drop shadow on display type and stickers — the console-UI signature.

--focus-ring.reason: Focus is a 2px sodium outline offset 3px.

--ease-standard.reason: The source uses plain ease / ease-in-out everywhere; stepped steps(2) for blinking pixel labels.

--container-max.reason: The playbook content column; the game is full-bleed fixed.
